description: This file declares the Shutdown class, which is a task for shutting down a WebAudio player within the Rialto server. It includes necessary headers, declares the class with constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references external classes and methods related to WebAudio player management.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A task class responsible for shutting down the WebAudio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown task with a reference to the IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate instance.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the shutdown process for the WebAudio player.
